apps.name: SwiftIPA
apps.subtitle: Sign IPAs, fast
apps.localizedDescription: SwiftIPA is a local, on-device IPA signer for iOS built around zsign compiled straight into the app. Bundle ID, name, version, entitlements, tweaks, modifiers — sign it all in seconds, resign the same app instantly from its own cache, or sign a whole batch of apps in parallel across every core on your device. No account, no server, no analytics.

- Fix three real bugs: extracted framework binaries kept their read-only zip permissions so zsign couldn't open them read-write to re-sign, the hidden install web view had no navigation delegate so itms-services links were silently dropped, and streamline the no-profile install to trigger automatically instead of requiring a second tap
- Update AltStore source for build 27

- Fix the previous build failure: a raw C array can't be captured directly inside an Objective-C block, so copy the pipe fds into scalars first

- Fix update checker always reporting an update, make Sources tolerate one malformed app entry instead of dropping the whole list, reuse a real download progress reporter for Source downloads, surface zsign's actual failure reason instead of a generic message, load the no-profile install through a hidden web view instead of a visible Safari sheet, and clean up Settings/Library/AppDetail text
- Update AltStore source for build 24

- Simplify the install screen to just the primary Safari-based flow, dropping the localhost and certificate fallback buttons from the ready state

- Fix the itms-services manifest URL losing its fetchurl parameter to under-escaping, and add a localhost fallback for the no-profile install path
